roll_call: Today I will find the courage to face the world with a sentence.
I will begin with one small mark and the nearly invisible space between things.
I will tell you not just what I saw, but how I passed through it.
deploy: Let us draw the space first. Memory gives itself away there before it does in time.
Please do not try to read it all at once. This breath needs time.

battle_win: We have already crossed into a different place. That movement is enough.
One small detail opened the whole. I will defend that delicacy to the end.

battle_draw: It is all right if it does not yield at once. Let us keep searching for the balance between strangeness and communion.
If it unsettled you, you were already reading it. That response is part of the conversation.
The ending matters less than the aftershock. Let us see where it travels next.
battle_lose: The sentence has not found my breath yet. I will write it whole again and revise it patiently.
I lost the space this time. I will rebuild the room of the scene from the beginning.

clash_attack: Do not rush to the period. I will leave an exclamation point in this opening.

roll_call: If trouble has broken out in Jing, I will travel day and night to reach it first. Delay will give Cao Cao the first move.
While the others spoke of surrender, I asked where my lord could possibly go.
I will hold the length of the Yangzi and gather allies who will stand against Cao Cao.
deploy: The north has troubles enough. Strike Huang Zu and take the approaches to Jing before the moment passes.
Entrust Jing to Liu Bei so we can resist Cao Cao together. Multiply his enemies and build an ally of our own.
Today's dispute should be settled face to face. Leave the armies a hundred paces away.
battle_win: Dismounting to receive me is still not honor enough. Call for me again when the Nine Provinces are united.
Cao Cao has withdrawn, but the alliance still needs tending. Guard the borders of Jing and Jiangdong together.
If Cao Cao dropped his brush at the news, the calculation worked. His enemies multiplied, and our ally stood.
battle_draw: An alliance is not held by sentiment alone. I will quiet suspicion at the border with goodwill and trust.
If lending one commandery creates another enemy for Cao Cao, it is not a loss alone.
I will settle right and wrong in the open, fix the border, and withdraw the troops. The alliance must outlast today's dispute.
battle_lose: After defeat, restore the camp first. If discipline falters, we will not hold the ground that remains.

Greed that abandons righteousness builds the stairway to disaster. I will correct the cause before I count the loss.
clash_attack: Set the armies a hundred paces away. You and I will meet with one blade each and settle the dispute.
You have taken Yi Province and still will not return the lands you borrowed. Stop turning the words aside.
An army whose cause is crooked grows weary. What can such force accomplish?
